Container.Name: Watchly
Container.Overview:
Watchly is a personalized recommendation engine for Stremio and Nuvio. It builds catalogs like "Top Picks for You" and "Because you loved ..." from your Stremio, Trakt, or Simkl watch history.
REQUIRES a MongoDB connection. Configure MONGODB_URLS with one or more semicolon-separated MongoDB connection URIs. New users are assigned to shards in the order listed.
You also need a free TMDB API key (https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api) and a long random Token Salt (e.g. from: openssl rand -hex 32). Host Name must be the URL where the addon is reachable from your Stremio clients.
After starting the container, open the WebUI to connect an account, pick catalogs, and get your addon manifest URL.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the configure page and the Stremio addon endpoints.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: TMDB API key, free at https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api

Config.Name: Token Salt
Config.Description: Long random secret used to encrypt stored credentials. Generate once (e.g. openssl rand -hex 32) and never change it, or existing user tokens become unreadable.

Config.Name: MongoDB URLs
Config.Description: One or more MongoDB connection URIs separated by semicolons. The first shard receives new users until it reaches the allocation threshold.

Config.Name: MongoDB Max Storage Bytes
Config.Description: Application-level capacity estimate per shard (512 MiB default). Adjust for your MongoDB plan.

Config.Name: MongoDB Allocation Threshold
Config.Description: Stop assigning new users to a shard at this fraction of configured capacity.

Config.Name: Host Name
Config.Description: URL where the addon is reachable from your Stremio clients (used in the manifest and OAuth callback URLs). Use your public HTTPS URL if you expose Watchly outside your LAN.

Config.Name: Allow Signups
Config.Description: Set to False to lock this instance to existing accounts: no new users can sign up.

Config.Name: Trakt Client ID
Config.Description: Optional. Trakt API app client id, to let users connect Trakt accounts.

Config.Name: Trakt Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional. Trakt API app client secret.

Config.Name: Simkl Client ID
Config.Description: Optional. Simkl API app client id, to let users connect Simkl accounts.

Config.Name: Simkl Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional. Simkl API app client secret.
